edge.weight_semantics: Retrieval-priority hint only; not probability or truth score
edge.temporal_scope: Null unless the source provides an explicit temporal scope; a year mention is not a validity interval.

rules: Every edge has one source and one target; inverse traversal is explicit.
Every claim-bearing edge preserves source page ID, title, path, revision, and a locator.
Wiki links, category membership, and year mentions are not semantic in-world claims.
Contradictory claims remain separate and are surfaced in diagnostics.
Transitive semantic edges require independent validation of every hop.
